text: Lets an app or agent make tool calls to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools via MCP

text: Provides built-in user authentication for connected apps via MCP, eliminating need to build OAuth flows or manage token storage/refresh
quote: Pipedream Connect includes built-in user authentication for more than APIs via MCP, which means you don’t need to build any authorization flows or deal with token storage and refresh

text: Automatically handles authorization/token logic inside the MCP server with no extra developer implementation
quote: This is handled automatically by Pipedream’s MCP server and there’s no additional implementation required

text: SDK client can automatically load all available tools with a single call

text: MCP server supports both SSE and streamable HTTP transports dynamically with zero client/dev configuration
quote: The Pipedream MCP server supports both SSE and streamable HTTP transport types dynamically, with no configuration required by the developer or MCP client.

text: End users can connect their own accounts directly through the hosted MCP endpoint

text: Users can revoke access to their connected accounts at any time
